meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 你提供书名、作者名和目标平台后,它会判断题材风格、编写英文提示词,调用 GPT-Image-2 生成带书名和作者署名的网文封面,再按平台上传尺寸裁剪导出。
howto.when: 当你说 /story-cover、/封面,或「帮我做个封面」等需求时接管;它先收集书名、笔名、目标平台和输出目录。Codex CLI 会话有内置 ImageGen 时优先走内置通路。

say.text: 帮我给《长夜行》做个封面,笔名林川,发番茄
say.note: 先问清书名笔名,再出 2-3 个构图方案

say.text: 用这张参考图生成封面,改成古言风格

say.note: 按平台上传像素裁剪,另存上传版

howto.what_en: Give it a book title, pen name and target platform; it picks the genre style, writes the English prompt, calls GPT-Image-2 to render a cover with title and author name, then crops it to the platform's upload size.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-cover, /封面, or requests like 'make me a cover'; it first collects title, pen name, platform and output directory. Codex CLI prefers its built-in ImageGen.

say_en.text: Make a cover for 'Long Night', pen name Lin Chuan, for 番茄
say_en.note: It asks for title and pen name, then drafts 2-3 layouts

say_en.text: Use this reference image and switch the style to 古言
Make the cover 600x800 and save to ./covers/Long Night
say_en.note: Crops to platform upload pixels, saves an upload version
